additional_info.subject: ID0386252-DC/Si-D/DE[Leipzig] - ELMS CRM:00315001979
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
The request is to enable ELMS for this customer from Leipzig. I don't have the Serial Number as we are currently waiting for a reply.
To enable the ELMS all you have to do is follow this 2 simple steps:
Enable ELMS in PLC Configuration (SCB):
Enable VLAN in Router 1 configuration:
After you enable these configurations, the customer should be able to ping and receive our data via Modbus. Please make sure that the ELMS ethernet cable is connected to the WAN port of Router 1 and not Router 2.
If it doesn't work, then it's possible that something is wrong on the customer side, I've never experienced an issue related to the charger while doing several ELMS configs. I send in attachment the document for the ELMS in case you have any doubts or questions just please check it.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0386252 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
DE

, due to one or more following reason (s) :

Hello Team, I cant configure the settings in SCB (maybe I dont have the permission?)
Could you do it for the customer? Following are the infirmation:
the serial number of the station in Heiterblick: MP/R0 170002741
the serial number of the station in Angerbrücke: MP/R0 170002761
Regarding the IP addresses: It does not matter which ones are set, it is only important that all components are in the same network. By default, the IP address of the controller is 192.168.1.100/255.255.255.0. The IP of the port is 3060.
